mapper.update: UPDATE mall_order SET status = 1, paid_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), paid_amount_fen = payable_amount_fen, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND created_at > DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)

UPDATE mall_order SET status = 4, cancelled_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0 AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order ( order_no, user_id, status, goods_amount_fen, shipping_fee_fen, payable_amount_fen, recipient_name, recipient_phone, recipient_address, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{order.orderNo}, #{userId}, 0, #{order.goodsAmountFen}, #{order.shippingFeeFen}, #{order.payableAmountFen}, #{order.recipient.name}, #{order.recipient.phone}, #{order.recipient.address}, #{order.createdAt}, #{order.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'PENDING_PAYMENT' WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING_SHIPMENT' WHEN 2 THEN 'PENDING_RECEIPT' WHEN 3 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN 4 THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE NULL END AS status_name, created_at, paid_at, shipped_at, completed_at, cancelled_at, goods_amount_fen, shipping_fee_fen, payable_amount_fen, paid_amount_fen, recipient_name, recipient_phone, recipient_address, NULLIF(TRIM(tracking_no), '') AS tracking_no FROM mall_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo}
